The '''Fifty-third Armored Platoon''' was a unit within the [[Republic Army]] that served in the [[Battle of Corellia]] against the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]]. [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Lesher]] and the walkers of the 53rd aided [[Havoc Squad]], the [[Eighty-first Infantry]], and the [[Safecrackers]] in assaulting the [[Bastion (Corellia)|Bastion]] and capturing [[General/Legends|General]] [[Arkos Rakton]].
